Fox's maker's page calculates 0.5 to 0.7 mm with a depth of 0.25 to 0.7 mm. On the test description, with hole 2 at an assumed 6 mm height, no diameter stepped up to 3 mm gives the written G5 or Ab5: they stay in the first register to at least 0.81 mm, split into two tones from about 1.8 mm, and settle near D5 by 3 mm. A 0.7 mm hole 0.7 mm deep refuses in the reed solver, so a shallow vent is untested
